channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Nemanja Bjelica | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Nemanja Bjelica from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jeff Teague on Nemanja Bjelica
item.description:
“Belly, Bjelica, whatever you say his name, shoutout to my guy. I had to play with him in Minnesota, we were teammates [2017-18].As soon as I walked into the locker room, he was like, 'Hey, I was going to f**k you up, brother. I was going to kill your whole family. Don't do that again.' I looked at him and said, 'Shut the f**k up.' He figured out we were joking all the time, me and him came kind of cool, but he was pissed.”

Jeff Teague on Nemanja Bjelica, Dec 1, 2023. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Nemanja Bjelica
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Goran Dragic on Bjelica:

“He's going to play a huge role in the spacing for our attackers to get inside the paint. But he's so much more, though. I played with him in Europe. He can put the ball on the floor and make plays.”

Goran Dragic on Nemanja Bjelica, Mar 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Luke Walton on Nemanja Bjelica
item.description:
Jason Anderson:Luke Walton on Nemanja Bjelica:

“I’m not going to play Belly again tonight. Me and him have talked. ... There’s some personal stuff and I’m just going to leave it at that,but we have been in communication and we are very confident in the player he is still.”

Luke Walton on Nemanja Bjelica, Jan 20, 2021. Source: Twitter @JandersonSacBee.

item.title: Sasha Djordjevic on Nemanja Bjelica, Vlade Divac, Bogdan Bogdanovic
item.description:
Djordjevic noted that Divac understands the situation as he also experienced the same problems during his career and has provided real help:

“Huge! Divac is exceptionally positive towards us, he understands our obligations. There are a few more details to be taken care of regarding Bogdanovic but as far as Bjelica goes it’s done. Bogdanovic underwent a surgery at the end of the season, so we have to keep an eye, but Vlade is a man who remembers the problems he had while playing with NBA teams and he is exceptionally willing to help. We’ve been in touch for the past three or four nights talking about it. I’m so glad both of them are on his team because it will help them in their further careers”

Sasha Djordjevic on Nemanja Bjelica, Vlade Divac, Bogdan Bogdanovic, Sep 2, 2018. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Nemanja Bjelica
item.description:
Thibs on a qualifying offer for Bjelica:

“Obviously you know how we feel about him. We haven’t done it yet, but we feel very strongly about him.”

Tom Thibodeau on Nemanja Bjelica, Jun 28, 2018. Source: Twitter @JonKrawczynski.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Nemanja Bjelica
item.description:
Jerry Zgoda:Thibs on if Bjelica will return tonight:

“We’ll see. He’s pretty much ready to go. I want to see how he responds to shootaround. He’ll warm up and we’ll take it from there.”

Tom Thibodeau on Nemanja Bjelica, Dec 25, 2017. Source: Twitter @JerryZgoda.

item.title: Brad Greenberg on Nemanja Bjelica
item.description:
“Like all high-level Euroleague players who make a lot of money overseas, it has to be a situation that makes sense financially, and where he gets an opportunity to play. Europeans don’t want to give up something that is comfortable, good and financially rewarding for a ‘what if?’ situation. Bjelica is talented enough to be in an NBA gym and not look out of place. That’s for sure.”

Brad Greenberg on Nemanja Bjelica, Apr 22, 2015. Source: Basketball Insiders.
